format: JavaScript (ES Modules, Playwright Test with Vue components)
description: This file is a test script using Playwright's component testing library for Vue.js. It tests navigation behavior within a Vue application by mounting the App component, simulating clicks on links, and verifying URL changes and content updates.

methods.name: navigate to a page by clicking a link
methods.description: A test case that mounts the main App component, simulates a user clicking a link to navigate to the Dashboard page, and verifies the resulting content and URL updates.
